source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Retrieve the relevant reports associated with the vehicle.
3. Identify the test date associated with the failure condition.
4. Access the brake test equipment data.
5. Determine the type of brake test conducted.
6. Note the type of vehicle tested.
7. Note the axle configuration of the vehicle.
8. Note the date of the test.
9. Note the type of test conducted (e.g., decelerometer, roller, and a discussion will be added later for dynamic load tests and decelerometer tests).
10. Note the make of the brake tester used.
11. Note the brake force or retardation efficiency data for the axles tested.
12. Note the percentage efficiency for each brake tested.
13. Note the sliding or drag on the brake (if applicable).
14. Note the direction of braking (front-to-rear or rear-to-front braking).
